noHaram.desc: The campaign does not promote alcohol, gambling, adult content, or any other prohibited products/services.

islamicValues.title: Respecting Islamic Values
islamicValues.desc: Images, messages, and the overall environment are respectful and do not mock or contradict Islamic principles.

honestRep.title: Honest Representation
honestRep.desc: The campaign avoids deceptive marketing, false claims, and ensures transparency in its offers.

noGambling.title: No Gambling
noGambling.desc: The campaign content does not include any promotion of gambling or betting.

noSexualContent.title: No Sexual Content
noSexualContent.desc: The campaign content does not include any sexual content or explicit insinuations.

noExplicitMusic.title: No Explicit Music
noExplicitMusic.desc: The campaign content does not include inappropriate music or lyrics.

noAlcohol.title: No Alcohol Promotion
noAlcohol.desc: The campaign content does not include any promotion of alcoholic beverages.

noSuspiciousCurrencies.title: No Suspicious Financial Transactions
noSuspiciousCurrencies.desc: The campaign content does not promote suspicious or untrustworthy currencies or financial transactions.

noUnrealisticProfit.title: No Unrealistic Profits
noUnrealisticProfit.desc: The campaign content does not promise unrealistic or misleading profit claims.
